body:
I have been an alcoholic for some time, and one night I decided to look for a way to increase my buzz.
I done some research online and found that I could use a nebulizer (Things that asthmatics use to inhale thier medication). I had been drinking and had a nebulizer around (I had asthma as a child). I proceeded to fill it with around 1/3rd of a shot of Jagermeister and only took 4 or 5 pulls off it.
What happened next can only be described as pure agony and feeling like I was going to pass out (which I did). I felt like I was having alcohol poisoning for around 24 hours. I thought I was going to be intoxicated for the rest of my life. Luckily I finally did come down and start to get a 'normal drunk' again.
I would not attempt this, it is extremely dangerous. I may have died if I took more pulls but thankfully I was cautious.
